title: German Chocolate Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle 1 cup pecans and coconut in the prepared pan.
Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour batter over coconut and pecans.
Beat cream cheese until smooth. Beat in melted butter, vanilla, salt, and powdered sugar. Stir in chocolate chips and remaining pecans.
Drop spoonfuls of cream cheese mixture over cake batter. Swirl together with a knife.
Bake 32-38 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely on a wire rack before serving.
substitutions: Use German Chocolate Cake mix instead of devil's food for more authentic flavor
Add coconut to the cream cheese mixture for extra flavor
Use chopped walnuts instead of pecans
